summary: Releases a sub-object of an unknown object. Calls the unconditional cleanup helper sub_540760, then, if the sub-object pointer stored at this+0x10FC is non-null, dispatches its vtable method at offset 8 (a release/destroy-style call), stores the return value into the object's own vtable pointer at this+0x0, and nulls this+0x10FC. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Call cleanup helper sub_540760(this) unconditionally before the optional sub-object release.
Read the sub-object pointer v2 = this[1087] at offset 0x10FC.
If the sub-object pointer at this+0x10FC is non-null, proceed with the vtable release call; otherwise skip the release block.
Call the sub-object's vtable method at offset 8 (vtable slot 2) on the pointer at this+0x10FC to release/destroy it.
Store the vtable release call's return value into *this (the object's vtable pointer at offset 0x0).
Set the released sub-object pointer this[1087] (offset 0x10FC) to 0.

unresolved: Concrete identity and layout of the sub-object are unknown; the vtable release method at offset 8 is inferred only from the dispatch pattern.
Return-value semantics of the vtable call (new vtable pointer vs. status) are unresolved.
The sub-object lifecycle (who allocates and later re-allocates this+0x10FC) is unresolved.
